product_metadata.title: The honey dispenser does not leak, with a syrup dispenser, a honey comb-shaped honey jar, a honey dispenser squeeze bottle, used as a syrup juice
features: Non-drip acrylic dispenser: While making your honey immediately available, it can also prevent messy honey from leaking. Use with sugar, maple syrup, chocolate syrup. No need to wait and shake the container to make your favorite sauce flow. Just press the release button on the handle and it will immediately flow from the bottom. Let go, and it stops immediately, with no signs of dripping or confusion.
We choose the tank made of acrylic instead of plastic to ensure the safety and taste of honey. Please note that the honey dispenser is not made of glass, but of acrylic material, making it durable.

Easy to use: The ABS holder can be stored conveniently and freely; the holder can be partially filled with warm water to prevent honey from crystallizing around the nozzle. Place the bottle on the base to keep the honey or syrup fresh and soft.
Innovative design: brand new high-quality, convenient and hygienic, easy to store and clean. The transparent acrylic resin allows you to clearly see the excess honey.
The capacity of the container is about 1 cup (7 ounces) of honey, maple syrup, chocolate syrup, sugar or any similar liquid or condiment you want; as long as it is fluid and not dense!
description: -100% brand new and high quality.  -Food grade acrylic environmental protection material, non-toxic and environmentally friendly.  -Transparent acrylic allows you to clearly see the excess honey -The honeycomb design adds a little emotional charm to the kitchen.  -Convenient, fast, healthy, smell of honey, keep your hands and kitchen clean.  1: Close the bottom hole with an additional plug 2: Unscrew the top, inject the required syrup/honey, connect the top and remove the stopper 3: Put the honeycomb dispenser on the food 4: Hold down the lever and drizzle on food or drink 5: Release lever, bringing perfect drizzle Type: Honey dispenser Material: Acrylic Color: silver+white Size: 10 * 14.5cm / 3.9 * 5.7  Weight: about 130g Style: simple and modern
